title: Qualcomm starts India layoffs (Moneycontrol's sources via Business Today, Digit, Jagran English, 11 Nov 2026): about 1,000 of an estimated 20,000 India staff at risk, other reports lower; first exits 9 Nov in Bengaluru; Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi-NCR expected next; reported severance at least 3 months' salary plus tenure pay, one more month for signing within 3 days; Qualcomm hasn't confirmed numbers or terms
